bibliographic.title: Nootropic Wonderland
bibliographic.author: Sasha Lea Griffin
bibliographic.description: Nootropic Wonderland takes the well known and loved story of Alice in Wonderland but re-imagines the tale in a cyber age. Set in the post-apocalyptic ruminants of England Alice Rose, an aspiring engineer living with her deranged father above an old takeaway in the Jack District ran by the tyrannical Neo-Red, an infamous crime organisation led by a man called Ace responsible for the productions and distribution of a highly addictive neurotic drug, street name: ‘Caterpillar’. But it turns out Neo-Red has bigger plans than just street deals and drive bys. Alice’s only hopes of stopping them from destroying her town, is to team up with the cynical android Lapin.
